title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Big game tonight Greg
Just make sure it isn’t postponed. I’m already bracing for it
F U
Hey man, I want this game played as much as anyone. Believe me, I need an off day
You need a new football coach is what you need
Emphasized “You need a new football coach is what you need ”
You and I are gonna fight on Friday
I miss you that’s why I’m fucking with you
I miss you too. That’s why we’re gonna fight.
Liked “I miss you too. That’s why we’re gonna fight. ”
Why aren’t Rod and Mario on tonight?
They’ve been doing the whole series
All of a sudden Gibby and Shep show up
Ask them, but rumor has it they’re suspended
Ooooh
[Attachment: Image]
I only have a few details so I’m counting on you to find out more
That was an audible “ooooh” too
I noticed it right away
Gibby, FSD producer, Rod haven’t answered
I got a call saying they fought and not to talk about it
Oh wow
They don’t like each other!!!
Same rules as always: I never told you any of this. But I believe it was physical.
You’re right though, they definitely hate each other
Omgggg
Dude it was boiling over in Minnesota
Call me after the game. Rod was talking shit about him to me like right in front of him
You told me about that already haha
They haven’t had dinner!
Oh ok
